name: @coveo/atomic-playground
description: Local playground for developing Atomic components against a real interface, with hot reload for Atomic and Headless changes

scripts.dev: concurrently --names headless-esm,headless-types,atomic,vite --prefix-colors cyan,blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @coveo/headless run dev:esm" "pnpm --filter @coveo/headless run dev:definitions" "pnpm --filter @coveo/atomic run dev:lit" "vite"
